key_reasoning.reason: Core fix spans the membership router (fixed-500 mapping), ProjectAssignmentService member-add path and a new shared_project_budget module, with shared-row helpers consolidated in budget_models/budget_service/project_budget_service (base M). SQLActivityEventRepository.insert/async_insert is a core shared utility with 18 call sites across 6 services, so its failure-semantics change lifts scope to L.

Closest pattern is the async ProjectBudgetService._ensure_shared_child_budget, which the new sync ensure_shared_project_budget_row ports into the caller's session (explicit flush to order the insert before the allocation FK). The activity insert change (pre-flush outside the SAVEPOINT so caller failures propagate instead of PendingRollbackError) has no precedent and alters behaviour for every caller (base M). Bumped to L: error-path and transaction-state assertions required a new tests/codemie/sqlite_harness.py, used only by the two new sqlite tests, so no existing test template covered this defensive pattern.

Diffstat reports 13 files (870+/88-): 7 source files across rest_api/routers, service/activity, service/budget and service/project, plus 6 test files including a new sqlite harness and new sqlite-backed tests; 11-15 files maps to XL.
